segments.title: Greenland Pressure & Trump Press Conference
segments.notes: Case opens with Pepito's cold-open sign-on; covers Trump's Greenland acquisition rhetoric, NATO comments, leaked Macron texts, and a secondhand Nobel Peace Prize; Jake appears at desk stuck in mud/cement.

segments.title: Trailer Roundup: Bait, The Humanoid, Vampires of the Velvet Lounge
segments.notes: Trent (Case's movie persona) reviews trailers with Pepito in the interview room; includes BBC's 'Bait,' 1979's 'The Humanoid,' and 'Vampires of the Velvet Lounge' starring Stephen Dorff; Flash Polls malfunction.

segments.title: Chat News: Emu Handcuffs, Ben Hooper Feud, Fart Science, Don Lemon, AI Twin, Arby's
segments.notes: Case and Jeff Ripple process cream.team Discord submissions: overdue library book, emu handcuffing (Jeff does Ben Hooper impression), 'are you dead' Chinese app, fart-sniffing Alzheimer's study (Jeff triggers Chet bit), Don Lemon/DOJ clash, water/AI stats, male libido peak study, AI digital twin, Arby's steak bites and meat carrots.

segments.title: Wood Dad Astral Projects Into Session
segments.notes: Dr. Chath's therapy session hijacked by Jeb's father (Wood Dad) projecting from his wooden imprisonment; discusses death, Jeb's incompetence, meat carrots, and spectral glasses; Case realizes he cannot distinguish Wood Dad from the wood.

segments.title: Arby's & 3D-Printed Meat Debate; New Poll System Debut
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate Arby's quality and 3D-printed meat via new mod-triggered poll commands (!mc, !munch, !crumb, !mnc); Crum endorses wet meats, Munch defends farm animals; both debut finger-gun 'crumb shot' and 'kill shot' choreography.

segments.title: Chips (Fries) Wash Ashore in Eastbourne
segments.notes: DJ Newsic auto-tunes a song about thousands of British chip/fry bags washing up on Eastbourne beaches from shipping containers, volunteer cleanup, veterinary concerns, and wildfire risk; Case raids Ovali to close.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored Tuesday Newsday covering Trump's Greenland push, oversaw chaotic studio with cement-trapped Jake, Trent movie segment, therapy invasion, and Munch & Crum poll debut.

characters.name: Jake
characters.notes: studio guest. Appeared at news desk covered in mud/cement, became stuck to chair, and required crowbar and blowtorch extraction by Peter Gibbon.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Extracted Jake from cement trap, claimed to have eaten and excreted cement himself, and remained stuck to his own chair.

characters.name: Trent
characters.notes: movie correspondent. Hosted Trent at the Movies segment reviewing trailers for Bait, The Humanoid, and Vampires of the Velvet Lounge alongside Pepito.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Delivered chat news including emu handcuffing, Ben Hooper impression, fart-science bit, Don Lemon/DOJ story, and Arby's steak bites coverage.

characters.name: Dr. Chath
characters.notes: therapist. Conducted therapy session largely derailed by Wood Dad's astral projection, offering minimal input before Wood Dad declared a breakthrough.

characters.name: Wood Dad (Jeb's Dad)
characters.notes: therapy guest. Astral-projected from wooden imprisonment into therapy, bickered with Jeb about his death, and claimed breakthrough when Case couldn't distinguish him from the wood.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debated Crum on Arby's and 3D-printed meat, debuted new mod-triggered poll system, and performed 'kill shot' finger-gun choreography.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued Arby's is bad but he'd eat it anyway including 3D-printed meat, advised on new poll system, and demonstrated 'crumb shot' finger guns.

characters.name: DJ Newsic
characters.notes: musical correspondent. Closed broadcast with auto-tuned song about British chips (fries) washing ashore in Eastbourne, volunteer cleanup, and wildfire risk.

lore_notes.fact: Ate cement, defecated cement, and became stuck to his chair [36:37].
Wears a 'piss jacket' made exclusively of his own urine [36:37].
Performed a 'Chet Guy the Science Eyes' bit claiming a 100% protein plus lawn grass diet makes his farts 'clinical grade chemical weapons' that boost brain function [1:10:06].
Demonstrated astral projection from his wooden imprisonment into the therapy studio using 'spectral glasses' [1:42:47].
New Munch & Crum poll system deployed: mods can trigger polls via !mc, !munch, !crumb, or !mnc with slash-separated options [2:02:55].

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchored a Tuesday Newsday broadcast covering Trump's renewed Greenland acquisition threats, a Don Lemon DOJ confrontation, and assorted chat-sourced oddities before Trent reviewed trailers, Jeff Ripple delivered a fart-science bit, Dr. Chath hosted a therapy session invaded by Jeb's astral-projecting father, Munch and Crum debated Arby's using a new mod-triggered poll system, and DJ Newsic closed with a song about British fries washing ashore in Eastbourne.
